import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAXN = 66;
    static int r, c, n;
    static String s;
    static long[][] comb = new long[MAXN][MAXN];
    static int[] cntA = new int[MAXN], cntB = new int[MAXN];
    static List<Long>[] partials = new ArrayList[MAXN], partialsZero = new ArrayList[MAXN];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
            partials[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            partialsZero[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static void precompute() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= n; ++i) {
            comb[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j)
                comb[i][j] = comb[i - 1][j - 1] + comb[i - 1][j];
        }
    }

    static long calcDiff(int conf, int a_bef, int b_bef) {
        long total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= c; ++i) {
            if ((conf & (1 << i)) != 0) {
                b_bef++;
                total -= comb[b_bef - 1][r - 1] * (comb[n - b_bef][r] - comb[a_bef][r]);
            } else {
                a_bef++;
                total += comb[a_bef - 1][r - 1] * (comb[n - a_bef][r] - comb[b_bef][r]);
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    static boolean validConf(int conf) {
        for (int i = 0; i <= c; ++i) {
            if (s.charAt(2 * r + c + i) == 'A' && ((conf >> i) & 1) == 1) return false;
            if (s.charAt(2 * r + c + i) == 'B' && ((conf >> i) & 1) == 0) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    static void process() {
        int total_conf = 1 << (c + 1);
        for (int conf = 0; conf < total_conf; ++conf) {
            int b_count = Integer.bitCount(conf);
            int a_count = c + 1 - b_count;
            if (validConf(conf))
                partials[a_count].add(calcDiff(conf, r + c - a_count, r + c - b_count));
            else
                partialsZero[a_count].add(calcDiff(conf, r + c - a_count, r + c - b_count));
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= c + 1; ++i) {
            Collections.sort(partials[i]);
            Collections.sort(partialsZero[i]);
        }
    }

    static long getCoef(int conf) {
        int i;
        for (i = 0; i <= c; ++i) {
            if ( (((conf >> i) & 1) != (conf & 1)) ) break;
        }
        for (int j = i; j <= c; ++j) {
            if (s.charAt(2 * r - 1 + j) == 'A' && (((conf >> j) & 1) == 1)) return 0;
            if (s.charAt(2 * r - 1 + j) == 'B' && (((conf >> j) & 1) == 0)) return 0;
        }
        int setA = r - 1 + ( ((conf & 1) == 0) ? i : 0 );
        int setB = r - 1 + ( ((conf & 1) == 1) ? i : 0 );
        if (setA < cntA[2 * r - 2 + i]) return 0;
        if (setB < cntB[2 * r - 2 + i]) return 0;
        int total = setA + setB - cntA[2 * r - 2 + i] - cntB[2 * r - 2 + i];
        return comb[total][setA - cntA[2 * r - 2 + i]];
    }

    static void updateAnswer(long[] ans, long[] act) {
        if (act[0] < 0) act[0] = -act[0];
        if (ans[0] > act[0]) {
            ans[0] = act[0];
            ans[1] = act[1];
        } else if (ans[0] == act[0]) {
            ans[1] += act[1];
        }
    }

    static long solve() {
        int total_conf = 1 << (c + 1);
        long[] answer = {Long.MAX_VALUE, 0};
        for (int conf = 0; conf < total_conf; ++conf) {
            int b_count = Integer.bitCount(conf);
            int a_count = c + 1 - b_count;
            long act = calcDiff(conf, r - 1, r - 1);
            long coef = getCoef(conf);
            int index = Collections.binarySearch(partials[c + 1 - a_count], -act);
            if (index >= 0) {
                long val = partials[c + 1 - a_count].get(index) + act;
                if (Math.abs(val) <= answer[0]) {
                    long count_coef = countInVector(partials[c + 1 - a_count], partials[c + 1 - a_count].get(index));
                    updateAnswer(answer, new long[]{Math.abs(val), coef * count_coef});
                }
            } else {
                int insertionPoint = -index - 1;
                if (insertionPoint < partials[c + 1 - a_count].size()) {
                    long val = partials[c + 1 - a_count].get(insertionPoint) + act;
                    if (Math.abs(val) <= answer[0]) {
                        long count_coef = countInVector(partials[c + 1 - a_count], partials[c + 1 - a_count].get(insertionPoint));
                        updateAnswer(answer, new long[]{Math.abs(val), coef * count_coef});
                    }
                }
                if (insertionPoint > 0) {
                    long val = partials[c + 1 - a_count].get(insertionPoint - 1) + act;
                    if (Math.abs(val) <= answer[0]) {
                        long count_coef = countInVector(partials[c + 1 - a_count], partials[c + 1 - a_count].get(insertionPoint - 1));
                        updateAnswer(answer, new long[]{Math.abs(val), coef * count_coef});
                    }
                }
            }
            long zero_coef = 0;
            int indexZero = Collections.binarySearch(partialsZero[c + 1 - a_count], -act);
            if (indexZero >= 0) {
                long val = partialsZero[c + 1 - a_count].get(indexZero) + act;
                long count_coef = countInVector(partials[c + 1 - a_count], partialsZero[c + 1 - a_count].get(indexZero));
                if (Math.abs(val) <= answer[0]) {
                    updateAnswer(answer, new long[]{Math.abs(val), zero_coef * count_coef});
                }
            } else {
                int insertionPointZero = -indexZero - 1;
                if (insertionPointZero < partialsZero[c + 1 - a_count].size()) {
                    long val = partialsZero[c + 1 - a_count].get(insertionPointZero) + act;
                    long count_coef = countInVector(partials[c + 1 - a_count], partialsZero[c + 1 - a_count].get(insertionPointZero));
                    if (Math.abs(val) <= answer[0]) {
                        updateAnswer(answer, new long[]{Math.abs(val), zero_coef * count_coef});
                    }
                }
                if (insertionPointZero > 0) {
                    long val = partialsZero[c + 1 - a_count].get(insertionPointZero - 1) + act;
                    long count_coef = countInVector(partials[c + 1 - a_count], partialsZero[c + 1 - a_count].get(insertionPointZero - 1));
                    if (Math.abs(val) <= answer[0]) {
                        updateAnswer(answer, new long[]{Math.abs(val), zero_coef * count_coef});
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return answer[1];
    }

    static long countInVector(List<Long> list, long value) {
        int count = 0;
        for (Long v : list) {
            if (v.equals(value)) count++;
        }
        return count;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        r = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        s = br.readLine();
        n = 2 * (r + c);
        precompute();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            cntA[i] = cntA[i - 1] + (s.charAt(i - 1) == 'A' ? 1 : 0);
            cntB[i] = cntB[i - 1] + (s.charAt(i - 1) == 'B' ? 1 : 0);
        }
        process();
        System.out.println(solve());
    }
}
